text:
oliver: Heads-up — PR #324 preview failing CI (linkcheck + vale + spell). failing step: docs-preview/linkcheck. link to logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/docs/324/logs :frowning:

dev-docs-bot: docs-preview failed on commit 7a1f3d2 — linkcheck (3 broken), vale (2 warnings), markdown-lint (line-length). See artifacts: https://ci.internal/artifacts/324

maria: @oliver thanks for flagging. I can take the vale warnings. likely our new rule on passive-voice for migration guide is noisy.

alex: I can run the linkcheck locally and patch the 3 bad links. quick check: two are internal anchors that changed in the redirect, one is an external github link 404.

sam: Who's able to approve after fixes? I'm in a meeting at 10:30 PT but can review after. If this needs to go out before EOD, we should coordinate.

linda: FYI the markdown-lint line-length is from the SDK snippet block — we can wrap the long URL or move it to a reference link.

oliver: Plan: @alex handle links, @maria apply vale rule exemptions in that migration guide and add a short comment explaining rationale, @linda fix the snippet formatting. I'll re-run preview and ask for a quick approve from @sam when green.

alex: Starting linkcheck now.

maria: I'll push a small .vale.ini tweak and an inline <!-- vale: off --> around the noisy paragraph. Will include a comment so reviewers know why.

linda: Fixing codeblock wrap — will replace inline long URL with [package-download](https://downloads.example.com/redwood-sdk/v1) ref link.

dev-docs-bot: New preview build queued (324 -> 7a1f3d2). linkcheck now: running...

dev-docs-bot: linkcheck passed. vale: 1 warning remaining (suggested wording: "recommended" -> "recommended for production"). markdown-lint: passed.

oliver: @maria can you handle that last vale nit? should be one-liner.

maria: Pushed wording tweak. CI rerun.

dev-docs-bot: All checks passed for PR #324. Preview URL: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/324

sam: Quick look — lgtm from me. :thumbsup:

oliver: Awesome. I'm going to merge and backport to release branch. Will tag in release notes.

alex: thanks all — glad that was just a small set.

linda: :shipit:

oliver: merged and backported (release/v1.4). closing thread. thanks!
